topics.name: On-device audio ML: research
topics.description: New architectures and papers for audio ML that can run on-device: speech enhancement, keyword spotting and VAD, speaker identification, sound event detection, spatial audio and direction-of-arrival, audio tokenizers and audio foundation models.
queries: new speech enhancement or keyword spotting neural network paper
on-device audio deep learning architecture research paper
sound event detection or speaker verification or spatial audio model paper

topics.name: On-device audio ML: edge applications
topics.description: Shipping products and announcements that put audio AI on the device: earbuds, hearables, hearing aids, smart speakers, in-car audio and wearables, including features like adaptive ANC, conversation boost and on-device voice assistants.
queries: earbuds hearables on-device AI audio feature launch
AI hearing aid chip or feature announcement
in-car voice assistant on-device audio AI announcement

topics.name: Edge AI hardware & NPUs
topics.description: Launches, benchmarks and SDK releases for microcontroller and edge NPUs and SoCs.
queries: Arm Ethos NPU or Cortex-M AI chip announcement
NXP or STMicroelectronics or Qualcomm or Infineon edge AI processor announcement

topics.name: Edge model compression & deployment toolchain
topics.description: Quantization, pruning, distillation and small on-device language and audio models, plus the compilers and runtimes that deploy them to edge hardware.
queries: ExecuTorch or LiteRT or TFLite Micro release
LLM quantization INT4 on-device inference paper
small language model on-device deployment news
